name: Orbit Dash
description: Guide your little spacecraft through a field of moving stars and collect glowing orbs.

name: Desert Sandbox
description: Explore a 3D desert sandbox with vehicles, interactive objects and physics-based chaos.

name: Neon Drift
description: A fast top-down arcade racer with drifting, boost pads, traffic, lap records and unlockable tracks.

name: Circuit Shift
description: A route-building logic puzzle: rotate tiles, connect the power source to every receiver and solve increasingly tricky boards.

name: Star Salvager
description: Pilot a tiny salvage ship, tow drifting cargo, dodge hazards, upgrade your engine and complete contracts across a starfield.

name: Garden Architect
description: Build a tiny living island: place plants, water channels and habitats, balance resources and discover ecosystem combos.

name: Pattern Pulse
description: A rhythm-and-memory challenge with evolving sequences, streak multipliers, difficulty settings and a daily-style endless mode.
